database_note: The orders table records customer transactions, linking to customers via customerid, employees via employeeid, and shippers via shipvia. The order_details table captures individual line items within those orders, connecting to orders via orderid and to products via productid. Products serve as the central item lookup, linking to categories via categoryid and suppliers via supplierid. Other tables provide descriptive context: customers, employees, shippers, suppliers, and products hold entity details. Territories and regions define geographic areas, linked through employeeterritories which connects employees to territories. Note that customerdemographics and customercustomerdemo are empty and unused. Use orderid to join orders with order_details, and productid to join order_details with products.
